name: smwgraphics-baby-bumpty
title: Baby Bumpty
description:
A graphic replacement for this sprite. Just make sure to change the extra bytes so that the sprite uses the correct palette.

Fun little idea I had when I was making some overworld sprite graphics for Arinsu. When I showed them off, somebody said that they could look nice as replacements for the Kun sprite.

So here we are! Fit's perfectly in any level that uses the regular Bumpty's as well.
